{% assign newsletter_url = site.brevo_form_url | default: "" | strip %}# Anna-Lena Birkner

> Anna-Lena Birkner is an HR Business Partner (People & Culture) with nine years in HR. She supports founders, team leads and growing teams with interim HR and parental-leave cover, workshops for teams and leads, and a free Team Snapshot.

Canonical website: https://annalenabirkner.com/

Working languages: German, English and Spanish.

Working format: Workshops run remote or on-site. Time commitment, duration and fee for interim HR are agreed around the client's situation.

Contact: info@annalenabirkner.com

## Start here

- [Free 30-minute orientation call](https://annalenabirkner.com/contact): A free video call of 30 minutes to talk through what is happening and whether there is a useful fit. No preparation needed. The same page has an option to write instead of booking.
- [Team Snapshot](https://annalenabirkner.com/team-snapshot/): A free five-minute self-assessment for teams unsure what is getting in the way. Six questions about how work runs today, with an instant score for each area, practical tips for the weaker areas and a PDF summary to download. {% if newsletter_url != "" %}No sign-up needed: the answers aren’t stored, and nothing leaves the browser unless the visitor chooses to join the optional quarterly newsletter offered with the results.{% else %}No sign-up; it runs entirely in the browser and nothing is sent or stored.{% endif %}

## Services

No prices are published on the site; scope and fee are agreed in a first conversation.

- [Interim HR & parental-leave cover](https://annalenabirkner.com/#interim-hr-business-partner): An experienced HR Business Partner in the client's team, for a gap, a parental leave or a growth phase. Areas: recruiting & onboarding, HR processes & structure, HR operations & benefits, data & reporting, support for team leads. Tools: Workday, SAP, Personio, time-tracking systems, Notion, Google Workspace. Time commitment, duration and fee are agreed on request.
- [Workshops](https://annalenabirkner.com/#workshops): Workshops for founders, decision-makers and team leads whose structures need to keep up with growth. Format: 1–2 hours, or tailored to the team. Setting: remote or on-site. Languages: German, English, Spanish. Overview PDF: [English](https://annalenabirkner.com/assets/downloads/workshop-overview-anna-lena-birkner.pdf), [German](https://annalenabirkner.com/assets/downloads/workshop-uebersicht-anna-lena-birkner.pdf).
- [Team Snapshot](https://annalenabirkner.com/team-snapshot/): Free, five minutes, no sign-up (see above).
- [Free 30-minute orientation call](https://annalenabirkner.com/contact): To find the right next step together.

## Workshop topics

- Fair AI in recruiting
- Bias awareness in teams
- Keeping working parents on board
- Making remote teams work
- Constructive communication, with hands-on practice

## Selected work

The case studies on the About page describe Anna-Lena’s role and the purpose of the work, not measured results.

- [About Anna-Lena Birkner](https://annalenabirkner.com/about/): How she works, a short introduction and the three case studies below.

- [Case 01: Mindfulife](https://annalenabirkner.com/about/#projects): At Mindfulife, a psychology-led meditation and wellbeing company, Anna-Lena leads People & Culture and works closely with the founders: employee lifecycle, people infrastructure (contracts, digital personnel structures, documentation, repeatable workflows) and founder partnership.
- [Case 02: Relief Applications](https://annalenabirkner.com/about/#projects): At Relief Applications, a humanitarian technology company, Anna-Lena worked across business development (including proposal development), project delivery and people operations, and stepped in as interim HR Business Partner for a distributed team.
- [Case 03: State Street Bank](https://annalenabirkner.com/about/#projects): At State Street Bank, a global financial services company, Anna-Lena worked on processes across People & Culture, monthly payroll, German employee benefits and pensions, with the aim of making recurring work simpler, more reliable and less manual. Areas: process improvement and automation, the monthly payroll cycle, and the German employee benefits and pension programme.

## Journal: Human in the Loop

- [Journal overview](https://annalenabirkner.com/blog/): Essays by Anna-Lena Birkner on AI, work and society, plus notes on tools, taste, clarity and human judgement. In English.

## Kurzüberblick auf Deutsch

Anna-Lena Birkner ist HR Business Partnerin (People & Culture) mit neun Jahren HR-Erfahrung. Sie unterstützt Gründer:innen, Teamleads und wachsende Teams. Angebote: Interim-HR & Elternzeitvertretung, Workshops (1–2 Stunden oder individuell für Ihr Team, remote oder vor Ort; Themen: Faire KI im Recruiting, Bias-Bewusstsein im Team, Berufstätige Eltern halten, Remote-Teams, die funktionieren, Konstruktive Kommunikation mit Praxisübungen) und der kostenlose Team-Snapshot. Preise stehen nicht auf der Website; Umfang und Honorar werden im Gespräch geklärt. Das Journal ist auf Englisch.
